description.p: **NOTE: This wrapper is not verified by, affiliated with, or supported by LabyMedia GmbH.**
**NOTE: LabyMod is not an official Minecraft product. It is not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.**
-- Incredible performance -- Freezes, lags, and poor FPS are a thing of the past: With LabyMod you will achieve the best performance and make your game feel smoother than ever before.
-- Your Game. Your Style -- It's up to you! Switch between a stunning, modern theme in high resolution or the classic and iconic Minecraft style at any time.

-- VoiceChat in Minecraft: -- Meet new friends or chat with familiar faces - with our VoiceChat you will have even more fun in-game. Our ready-to-go VoiceChat addon can be used on any multiplayer server without any additional setup required.

-- Ready for more? -- That's by far not all. LabyMod offers an improved server list, interactive screenshots, in-game widgets, friends, dozens of add-ons, support for Fabric and Forge and much more! Take a look at the website or download it now.

ul.li: Fixed launches occasionally failing or starting with incomplete game files when a network hiccup interrupted file resolution
* The launcher now retries transient failures and waits for all files to be ready before starting
Fixed a crash/launch failure caused by duplicate libraries (e.g. two copies of log4j) ending up on the classpath
Fixed the launcher creating a new desktop shortcut on every update
Fixed window corners not rendering squared-off correctly on Linux when rounded corners are disabled
Fixed an issue that prevented most of anonymous statistics to not be sent + also made the transmission more reliable
+ Added a "Maximized" window mode that starts the game filling your screen, configurable both globally and per instance
Restored the ability to rotate the main-menu player model up and down (hold Shift while dragging)
Fixed migrated modpacks loading the wrong mods, each migrated pack now keeps its own isolated mod set instead of pulling in the shared default mods
Fixed mod configs and keybinds (e.g. Litematica) not carrying over after migrating your modpacks to instances
Fixed the launcher's "Open mods folder" and the in-game mods folder pointing at different locations for migrated instances
Fixed a launch failure caused by permission errors (EPERM) when an instance's game directory is the root of a drive
Fixed a network race during launch that could leave the classpath incomplete
Fixed the launcher occasionally failing to open after corrupted data, and added a crash log to your Downloads folder to help diagnose startup failures
Reverted yesterdays changes regarding the LabyFabric config folders. Fixed upstream in LabyFabric.
Unified the on/off toggle switches across the global and instance settings
Temporarily disabled the "use native buttons" option while it's being reworked
Fixed the launcher auto-applying fullscreen on launch instead of respecting your saved video settings
Fixed mod configurations not being carried over to the correct path after migrating modpacks
Fixed release channels not loading properly in the global settings
Fixed the alignment of the reset resolution button in the settings

description.p: We've rebranded from "LabyMod Launcher" to Laby Launcher. The new name reflects what the launcher has become: it's no longer just for LabyMod.

You can now create instances for Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, Quilt and more, each with its own version, mods and configuration. And if you're coming from another launcher, you can import your existing setups from other launchers (e.g. MultiMC/Prism), with automatic detection doing most of the work for you.

The entire launcher has been redesigned around our new design language we recently used in our website relaunch. The overview, settings, news and logs have all been rebuilt to be cleaner and easier to navigate.

Alongside the visual rework, we added management features for mods, addons, resource packs, shaders, screenshots and servers directly in our launcher. The skin & cape library now loads faster, supports uploading your own skins, and includes a 3D cape preview.

Performance was a major focus this release. Startup no longer blocks on bad network or outages - alongside faster downloads for game files. On top of all the new work, we've cleaned up a huge backlog of long-standing bugs and broken behavior that had piled up over the years.
